title: Victoria Day trip with Butchart Garden and Malahat Skywalk
blurb: Immerse yourself in the natural wonders and historic charm of Vancouver Island with this private, expertly guided day tour departing directly from Victoria. Designed for travelers seeking a refined and personalized experience, this journey blends the iconic beauty of The Butchart Gardens with the breathtaking heights of the Malahat SkyWalk—all delivered with signature luxury, flexibility, and comfort.
